title: Penthouse Magazine November 1987 Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, November 1987 issue. Features "Our First Gay President — Out of the Closet, Finally," "Women for Porn — A Feminist Speaks Out," World's Top Arms Dealer interview blasting Reagan and North, and "Presidential Sex Testing" on the Gary Hart scandal.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
